bundle.shortDescription: Live plotter for numbers from serial, TCP and UDP
bundle.longDescription: PortDock Plot draws numbers arriving over serial, a TCP client connection or UDP as a live graph: comma/space/tab/semicolon text, Arduino-style name:value pairs, header names and fixed binary frames (start bytes, u8–f64, endianness, checksum), several channels on left and right axes, time or point windows, pause, cursor readout, two-point deltas, zoom and pan, a statistics table, CSV recording while receiving, and CSV/PNG export of the view.
